cards.name: Adeline, Resplendent Cathar
cards.oracle_text:
Vigilance
Adeline's power is equal to the number of creatures you control.
Whenever you attack, for each opponent, create a 1/1 white Human creature token that's tapped and attacking that player or a planeswalker they control.

cards.name: Call the Coppercoats
cards.oracle_text: Strive — This spell costs {1}{W} more to cast for each target beyond the first. Choose any number of target opponents. Create X 1/1 white Human Soldier creature tokens, where X is the number of creatures those opponents control.

cards.name: Transmogrifying Wand
cards.oracle_text: This artifact enters with three charge counters on it. {1}, {T}, Remove a charge counter from this artifact: Destroy target creature. Its controller creates a 2/4 white Ox creature token. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Rampart Architect
cards.oracle_text: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, create a 1/3 white Wall creature token with defender. Whenever a creature you control with defender dies, you may search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
